waiting.warmup.1: Count back from 20 to 1 in your head.
waiting.warmup.2: Count by threes as far as you can: 3, 6, 9…
waiting.warmup.3: Find three things around you shaped like a circle.
waiting.warmup.4: Think of a number, then of a number twice as big.
waiting.warmup.5: Name something that comes in pairs, and something that comes in threes.
waiting.warmup.6: Draw a triangle in the air with your finger. Now a square.
waiting.warmup.7: Count the corners of the room you're in.
waiting.warmup.8: Make up a short story with the number 7 in it.
waiting.warmup.9: Stretch up high, then reach down to your toes.

first_run.label: Welcome to MathTrail
first_run.lead: MathTrail gives a child olympiad-style maths tasks for grades 1 to 6, right here in the chat, and goes through every mistake. An adult sets it up: a parent or a tutor.
first_run.pseudonym: The child is known by a pseudonym alone: never a real name, a birth date or a school.
first_run.fill: A pseudonym and the grade, 1 to 6. If you like, also the child's interests, what they have not met at school yet, and the language of the cards.
first_run.data: In one file in your own Google Drive, which you can open, download or delete. MathTrail keeps nothing on its side.
first_run.confirm: I am the child's parent or tutor
card.unreadable: This card can't be shown here. The chat says the same in words.
